BiblicalUsage: The azarah is the court — the enclosed place around the temple where the people stood. Solomon built the great court and the inner court, and Ezekiel measures the court of the house, its borders and its gates, in the vision of the new temple. An enclosure set apart for God's house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the court matters because it says worship has a place — a bounded, holy space where the people meet their God. No one wanders in by accident.
